sentences.sentence: As they travel inland atspeeds in excess of 60 feet a year, they merge with the rich grass andscattered trees of the savanna.
sentences.translation: 它们以每年超过60英尺的速度向内地迁移，融入了热带稀树大草原的丰富草地和零星的树木。

sentences.sentence: A mature male lion rests in the grasses of the Kenyan savanna.
sentences.translation: 肯尼亚热带草原上，一头成年雄狮正在草丛里休息。

sentences.sentence: Like compression molding, this method is used to form thermoset materials and involves permanently curing the plastic in a mold under heat and pressure.
sentences.translation: 像压缩成型，使用这种方法，形成热固性材料和涉及永久固化塑料模具在高温下和压力。

translations.translation: 热烈欢迎, 大喝采, 大受欢迎, 欢呼

phrases.translation: 长时间起立鼓掌；起立致敬

sentences.sentence: The Chancellor’s entrance was greeted with a standing ovation (= everyone stood up ).
sentences.translation: 总理进来时，全体起立鼓掌欢迎。

sentences.sentence: Fans gave the rock group a thunderous ovation.
sentences.translation: 歌迷对这个摇滚乐队报以雷鸣般的掌声。

translations.translation: 热情, 热烈, 炽热

sentences.sentence: The non religious version, which reads strong excitement of feeling or something inspiring zeal or fervor.
sentences.translation: 从非宗教论来说是指强烈的兴奋感，或者是对某事的热情或激情。

sentences.sentence: This slow-motion disaster, demography insists, cannot be avoided without a major shift in resources.
sentences.translation: 这是一场缓慢进行的灾难，人口统计学仍坚持不能避免资源的主要转移。

phrases.translation: 人类体格学；身体人类学
进化人类学；演化的人类学

sentences.sentence: "In anthropology, you can't equate third gender with homosexuality," he said.
sentences.translation: “在人类学中，你不能将同性恋和第三性别混同，”他说。

sentences.sentence: When I was a student at Cambridge I remember an anthropology professor holding up a picture of a bone with 28 incisions carved in it.
sentences.translation: 当我还在剑桥读书的时候，我记得有一位人类学的教授拿出一张照片，上面是一根有28个切口的骨头。

sentences.sentence: Not to be the skunk at this party, but I think it's important to ask whether neuroscience reveals anything more than we already know from, say, anthropology.
sentences.translation: 我并不想成为派对上的讨厌鬼，但我认为很重要的是，要问清楚神经科学是否揭示出我们已知之外的东西，比如人类学。

sentences.sentence: No capitation, or other direct, tax shall be laid, unless in proportion to the census or enumeration herein before directed to be taken.
sentences.translation: 除按本宪法前文对人口普查或统计结果规定的比例征税外，不得征收人头税或其他直接税。

sentences.sentence: The Irish education department said that schools were getting more funding for basic operating costs following an increase in the capitation grant last year to €200 for each student.
sentences.translation: 爱尔兰教育部门说，去年政府为学生按人头提供的补助费已增加到每位200镑，各所学校基本运转资金也随之增加了。

translations.translation: 人相学, 人相, 脸, 相面术, 相貌, 地貌, 地势

sentences.sentence: He was fascinated by her physiognomy – the prominent nose, brooding eyes, and thick hair.
sentences.translation: 他被她的相貌—高挺的鼻梁、深邃的双眸和浓密的秀发—迷住了。

translations.translation: 人性, 人类, 博爱, 仁慈

phrases.translation: 违反人道罪；危害人类罪

sentences.sentence: We want a clean healthy environment for all humanity .
sentences.translation: 我们希望全人类拥有一个干净健康的生存环境。

sentences.sentence: crimes against humanity
sentences.translation: 反人类罪

sentences.sentence: And not just getting up for a sandwich -- eating from tubs of margarine or eating cigarettes and raw meat.
sentences.translation: 这可不仅 仅是起床拿一块三明治那么简单，而是吃大块的黄油或者香烟还有生肉。

sentences.sentence: Palm oil is an ingredient in an estimate third of all products on supermarket shelves, from biscuits and margarine to shampoo and confectionery.
sentences.translation: 在超市货架上，棕榈油是一种被估计使用率第三的食品配料，从饼干、人造黄油到洗发水到糖果都有它的足迹。

sentences.sentence: The group are holding two tourists hostage (= keeping them as hostages ) .
sentences.translation: 这伙人挟持了两名游客作为人质。

sentences.sentence: a family taken hostage at gunpoint
sentences.translation: 在枪口下被劫为人质的一家人

sentences.sentence: We now of no scripture which records the pure benignity of the gods on a New England winter night.
sentences.translation: 但没有一本书记录了新英格兰的冬夜，尽管它是上天仁慈的恩惠。

sentences.sentence: It is in vain for any man to usurp the name of Christian, without holiness of life, purity of manners, benignity and meekness of spirit.
sentences.translation: 任何人若没有圣洁的生活，正直的行为，仁慈与顺服的精神，那么僭取基督徒的名义是徒劳的。

sentences.sentence: However, the social insurance system of justice still needs benignity to provide value guidance and humanistic environment for its operation.
sentences.translation: 然而，正义的社会保障制度，仍需仁慈为其运行提供价值引导和人文环境。

sentences.sentence: ...the nomination of Texas Senator Lloyd Bentsen to be treasury secretary.
sentences.translation: …德克萨斯州议员劳埃德·本特森作财政部长的任命。

sentences.sentence: Befitting his ideology, Krugman has only one policy to propose, regardless of topic: Transfer more resources from the discipline and dynamism of markets to the inefficiency and cronyism of government.
sentences.translation: 与他的理念相衬，不管是什么主题，克鲁格曼只会提出一条经济政策：把更多的资源从有纪律和活力的市场转移到低效和任人唯亲的政府手中。

sentences.sentence: Cleaning up what looks like cronyism may be easier than the next step: shutting down the money pipeline from Department of Defense contracts to potential insurgents.
sentences.translation: 整顿这种任人唯亲之举可能比下一步措施要来得容易：关闭美国国防部向潜在叛军输送资金的通道。

sentences.sentence: Krugman replied that he was "sure that there's a large literature" on government cronyism and corruption.
sentences.translation: 克鲁格曼回应说他“确信有大量的著作”证明政府的任人唯亲和腐败。

sentences.translation: 管弦乐队为满场的观众演奏。

sentences.translation: 所有的宾馆都住满了。

text:
英语词汇 · GRE · 第 229 单元

devotion
音标：英 /dɪ'vəʊʃ(ə)n/  美 /dɪ'voʃən/
n. 热爱, 投入
短语：devotion to duty — 忠于职守(常用于正式嘉奖大会上)
短语：devotion aura — 虔诚光环；专注光环；热血灵光
例句：At first she was flattered by his devotion.
最初他的挚爱使她感到受宠若惊。

ardor
音标：英 /'ɑːdə/  美 /'ɑrdɚ/
n. 热诚, 情欲, 激情, 热情, 炽热

savanna
音标：英 /sə'vænə/  美 /sə'vænə/
n. 热带(或亚热带)稀树大草原
例句：As they travel inland atspeeds in excess of 60 feet a year, they merge with the rich grass andscattered trees of the savanna.
它们以每年超过60英尺的速度向内地迁移，融入了热带稀树大草原的丰富草地和零星的树木。
例句：A mature male lion rests in the grasses of the Kenyan savanna.
肯尼亚热带草原上，一头成年雄狮正在草丛里休息。

thermoset
n. 热固树脂,热固塑料
例句：Like compression molding, this method is used to form thermoset materials and involves permanently curing the plastic in a mold under heat and pressure.
像压缩成型，使用这种方法，形成热固性材料和涉及永久固化塑料模具在高温下和压力。

ovation
音标：英 /ə(ʊ)'veɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /o'veʃən/
n. 热烈欢迎, 大喝采, 大受欢迎, 欢呼
短语：standing ovation — 长时间起立鼓掌；起立致敬
例句：The Chancellor’s entrance was greeted with a standing ovation (= everyone stood up ).
总理进来时，全体起立鼓掌欢迎。
例句：Fans gave the rock group a thunderous ovation.
歌迷对这个摇滚乐队报以雷鸣般的掌声。

fervor
音标：英 /'fɜːvə/  美 /'fə:və/
n. 热情, 热烈, 炽热
例句：The non religious version, which reads strong excitement of feeling or something inspiring zeal or fervor.
从非宗教论来说是指强烈的兴奋感，或者是对某事的热情或激情。

aspiration
音标：英 /æspə'reɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /'æspə'reʃən/
n. 热望, 渴望
短语：aspiration biopsy — 针吸活组织检查
短语：aspiration pneumonia — [医]吸入性肺炎

demography
音标：英 /dɪ'mɒgrəfɪ/  美 /dɪ'mɑɡrəfi/
n. 人口统计学
例句：This slow-motion disaster, demography insists, cannot be avoided without a major shift in resources.
这是一场缓慢进行的灾难，人口统计学仍坚持不能避免资源的主要转移。

anthropology
音标：英 /,ænθrə'pɒlədʒɪ/  美 /'ænθrə'pɑlədʒi/
n. 人类学
短语：cultural anthropology — 文化人类学
短语：physical anthropology — 人类体格学；身体人类学
短语：social anthropology — 社会人类学
短语：evolutionary anthropology — 进化人类学；演化的人类学
短语：visual anthropology — 影视人类学
短语：biological anthropology — 生物人类学
例句："In anthropology, you can't equate third gender with homosexuality," he said.
“在人类学中，你不能将同性恋和第三性别混同，”他说。
例句：When I was a student at Cambridge I remember an anthropology professor holding up a picture of a bone with 28 incisions carved in it.
当我还在剑桥读书的时候，我记得有一位人类学的教授拿出一张照片，上面是一根有28个切口的骨头。
例句：Not to be the skunk at this party, but I think it's important to ask whether neuroscience reveals anything more than we already know from, say, anthropology.
我并不想成为派对上的讨厌鬼，但我认为很重要的是，要问清楚神经科学是否揭示出我们已知之外的东西，比如人类学。

capitation
音标：英 /kæpɪ'teɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /'kæpə'teʃən/
n. 人头税, 按人收费
例句：No capitation, or other direct, tax shall be laid, unless in proportion to the census or enumeration herein before directed to be taken.
除按本宪法前文对人口普查或统计结果规定的比例征税外，不得征收人头税或其他直接税。
例句：The Irish education department said that schools were getting more funding for basic operating costs following an increase in the capitation grant last year to €200 for each student.
爱尔兰教育部门说，去年政府为学生按人头提供的补助费已增加到每位200镑，各所学校基本运转资金也随之增加了。

physiognomy
音标：英 /,fɪzɪ'ɒ(g)nəmɪ/  美 /'fɪzɪ'ɑnəmi/
n. 人相学, 人相, 脸, 相面术, 相貌, 地貌, 地势
例句：He was fascinated by her physiognomy – the prominent nose, brooding eyes, and thick hair.
他被她的相貌—高挺的鼻梁、深邃的双眸和浓密的秀发—迷住了。

humanity
音标：英 /hjʊ'mænɪtɪ/  美 /hjʊ'mænəti/
n. 人性, 人类, 博爱, 仁慈
短语：crime against humanity — 违反人道罪；危害人类罪
例句：We want a clean healthy environment for all humanity .
我们希望全人类拥有一个干净健康的生存环境。
例句：crimes against humanity
反人类罪

margarine
音标：英 /,mɑːdʒə'riːn; 'mɑːgəriːn/  美 /'mɑrdʒərən/
n. 人造黄油
例句：And not just getting up for a sandwich -- eating from tubs of margarine or eating cigarettes and raw meat.
这可不仅 仅是起床拿一块三明治那么简单，而是吃大块的黄油或者香烟还有生肉。
例句：Palm oil is an ingredient in an estimate third of all products on supermarket shelves, from biscuits and margarine to shampoo and confectionery.
在超市货架上，棕榈油是一种被估计使用率第三的食品配料，从饼干、人造黄油到洗发水到糖果都有它的足迹。

hostage
音标：英 /'hɒstɪdʒ/  美 /'hɑstɪdʒ/
n. 人质, 抵押品
例句：The group are holding two tourists hostage (= keeping them as hostages ) .
这伙人挟持了两名游客作为人质。
例句：a family taken hostage at gunpoint
在枪口下被劫为人质的一家人

benevolence
音标：英 /bɪ'nev(ə)l(ə)ns; bɪ'nevəl(ə)ns; bɪ'nevələns/  美 /bə'nɛvələns/
n. 仁爱心, 善行

benignity
音标：英 /bɪ'nɪɡnətɪ/  美 /bɪ'nɪgnəti/
n. 仁慈, 善行
例句：We now of no scripture which records the pure benignity of the gods on a New England winter night.
但没有一本书记录了新英格兰的冬夜，尽管它是上天仁慈的恩惠。
例句：It is in vain for any man to usurp the name of Christian, without holiness of life, purity of manners, benignity and meekness of spirit.
任何人若没有圣洁的生活，正直的行为，仁慈与顺服的精神，那么僭取基督徒的名义是徒劳的。
例句：However, the social insurance system of justice still needs benignity to provide value guidance and humanistic environment for its operation.
然而，正义的社会保障制度，仍需仁慈为其运行提供价值引导和人文环境。

nomination
音标：英 /nɒmɪ'neɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,nɑmɪ'neʃən/
n. 任命
例句：...the nomination of Texas Senator Lloyd Bentsen to be treasury secretary.
…德克萨斯州议员劳埃德·本特森作财政部长的任命。

cronyism
音标：英 /'krəʊnɪɪz(ə)m/  美 /'kronɪɪzəm/
n. 任用亲信
例句：Befitting his ideology, Krugman has only one policy to propose, regardless of topic: Transfer more resources from the discipline and dynamism of markets to the inefficiency and cronyism of government.
与他的理念相衬，不管是什么主题，克鲁格曼只会提出一条经济政策：把更多的资源从有纪律和活力的市场转移到低效和任人唯亲的政府手中。
例句：Cleaning up what looks like cronyism may be easier than the next step: shutting down the money pipeline from Department of Defense contracts to potential insurgents.
整顿这种任人唯亲之举可能比下一步措施要来得容易：关闭美国国防部向潜在叛军输送资金的通道。
例句：Krugman replied that he was "sure that there's a large literature" on government cronyism and corruption.
克鲁格曼回应说他“确信有大量的著作”证明政府的任人唯亲和腐败。

commodity
音标：英 /kə'mɒdɪtɪ/  美 /kə'mɑdəti/
n. 日用品
短语：commodity inspection — 商品检验
短语：commodity economy — 商品经济
短语：commodity price — 商品价格
短语：commodity market — 商品市场
短语：commodity exchange — 商品交易所
短语：commodity inspection bureau — 商品检验局
短语：commodity circulation — 商品流通
短语：bulk commodity — 大宗商品，散装货物
短语：fake commodity — 假货
短语：commodity money — 商品（实物）货币
短语：commodity fair — 商品展览会；物资交流会
短语：name of commodity — 商品的名称，货物名称
短语：commodity classification — 商品分类
短语：commodity code — 商品编码
短语：commodity tax — 货物税；商品税
短语：purchase commodity — 购货；购进商品
短语：commodity stocks — 库存商品；商品库存
例句：agricultural commodities
农业商品
例句：Commodity prices fell sharply.
商品价格急剧下跌。

capacity
音标：英 /kə'pæsɪtɪ/  美 /kə'pæsəti/
n. 容量, 生产量, 容量, 智能, 才能, 能力, 接受力, 地位
短语：production capacity — 生产能力；生产力
短语：bearing capacity — 承载量；结果能力；产仔能力
短语：capacity for — …的能力
短语：carrying capacity — 承载能力；载运容量
短语：large capacity — 大容量
短语：high capacity — 大容量
短语：environmental capacity — 环境容量，环境负荷量；环境承载力
短语：storage capacity — 存储容量；蓄电池容量；积聚电容
短语：processing capacity — 处理能力；处理容量
短语：heat capacity — 热容；热容量
短语：load capacity — 负载能力，载重能力
短语：loading capacity — 负荷容量；载荷能力
短语：handling capacity — 吞吐量；处理能力；处理容量
短语：productive capacity — 生产能力
短语：adsorption capacity — 吸附容量；吸附能力
短语：financial capacity — 经济能力；财政的承受能力
短语：capacity building — 能力建设；能力建构
短语：ultimate bearing capacity — 极限承载力，极限承载量；轴承极限能力，承载量
短语：manufacturing capacity — 制造能力
短语：system capacity — 系统容量；系统运能
例句：The room had seating capacity for about 80.
这房间能坐80个人左右。
例句：The orchestra played to a capacity crowd (= the largest number of people who can fit into a hall, theatre etc ) .
管弦乐队为满场的观众演奏。
例句：All the hotels were filled to capacity .
所有的宾馆都住满了。
